about: Head-of-department officers, official email IDs and office postal addresses for the major GBA / BBMP departments, the 5 city corporations, the 8 legacy BBMP zonal offices, and the external oversight authorities. Compiled from official sources only (see sources[]). Every email/phone/PIN here was seen on an official page or official PDF — nothing is inferred. Where the only published address for a post is a Gmail/Yahoo account, emailIsOfficialDomain is false: that is what the authority itself publishes, so it is kept but flagged.

sourceHealth: site.bbmp.gov.in serves an EXPIRED TLS CERTIFICATE and much of its officer table is commented out of the HTML. Its contact.html still names Tushar Giri Nath as Chief Commissioner — roughly three post-holders out of date. This blocked the per-zone contact PDFs, which is why 4 of 8 zonal landlines are null.
bbmp.gov.in and gba.karnataka.gov.in are JavaScript SPAs and return no text to a fetcher; documents live on updates.bbmpgov.in and dl.bbmpgov.in.
There is no gba.gov.in domain and no @gba.gov.in mailboxes. All official GBA mail still runs on @bbmp.gov.in.
The old Lokayukta domain lokayukta.kar.nic.in no longer resolves; the live one is lokayukta.karnataka.gov.in.
Officer NAMES are as of 2025-12-08 and are ~7 months stale. Office emails, landlines and addresses are far more durable than the names attached to them.

For several of these the only published address is a Gmail/Yahoo account, captured in alternateEmail.

No officer name published for Chief Engineer (Storm Water Drain) or Chief Engineer (Lakes) — both posts are absent from the Dec-2025 GBA list, apparently because that work moved to B-SMILE and corporation-level Chief Engineers.
4 of 8 zonal office landlines are null: site.bbmp.gov.in serves an expired TLS certificate, which blocked the per-zone contact PDFs that are the only official source for those numbers.
GBA head-office switchboard (080-22660000) and helpline (1533) could not be confirmed on an official page fetched directly, so they are not asserted as fields.
No email published for the GBA Technical Vigilance Cell head post itself — only the Superintending Engineer and Executive Engineer TVCC mailboxes.

The gazette constituting the 5 corporations (Karnataka Gazette Extraordinary No. 522 English / No. 523 Kannada, 2 September 2025) is referenced by other official documents but could not be fetched from an official domain.
structuralFindings: The GBA Chief Commissioner is formally Administrator to all 5 City Corporations. None of the corporations has an elected council, so he is the single statutory escalation point above all five Commissioners.

Each corporation is internally split into Zone-01 / Zone-02, so the old 8 BBMP zones are now 10 corporation zones. Four of the five corporation HQs physically occupy former BBMP zonal office buildings.
All official GBA mail still runs on @bbmp.gov.in — there is no @gba.gov.in. But the 5 corporation Commissioners publish only Gmail addresses.
The Anti-Corruption Bureau has no valid recipient; anti-corruption complaints must go to the Karnataka Lokayukta Police.
